\ ---- what goes on, and what overlaps it --------------------------------------------------
\ mark_to_draw: need bit 6 for every live slot on screen (the logic's view) that this screen
\ does not show, or is taking off.
.mark_to_draw
{
    LDY #0
.each
    CPY act_n                       \ in the body Y < act_n, so C clear
    BEQ done
    STY ren_k
    LDX act,Y
    LDA need,X
    BMI not_shown                   \ coming off: goes back on if still there
    TXA
    ADC boff                        \ C clear (CPY act_n with Y < act_n)
    TAY
    LDA rec_xh,Y
    INC A                           \ 65C02 opcode: &FF (not shown) -> 0
    BNE next                        \ shown and staying
.not_shown
    STX ren_i
.candidate
    LDA movers_x_high,X             \ X = ren_i on both ways in
    BMI next                        \ no mover in the slot
    STA &C5                         \ get_mover_Y_x, inline and by X
    LDA movers_x_low,X
    STA mover_x_low
    LDA movers_type_and_colour,X
    AND #&7F
    TAX
    JSR check_if_mover_is_on_screen \ carry set if not
    BCS next
    LDX ren_i
candidates.new:
\ ---- what goes on, and what overlaps it --------------------------------------------------
\ mark_to_draw: need bit 6 for every live slot on screen (the logic's view) that this screen
\ does not show, or is taking off.
.mark_to_draw
{
    LDA render.classify_xh          \ the records' x high for this screen: rec_xh + boff, as classify's operand has it
    STA c1_rec
    LDY act_n                       \ the list from its end (each slot is judged alone, so the order is free)
.each                               \ next's way back in: Y = the entry just done (it stored its index - 1), + 1
    DEY
    BMI done
    LDX act,Y
    LDA viewport_right_low          \ check_if_mover_is_on_screen's right edge, first and inline (a slot that
    CMP movers_x_low,X              \ is off the right changes nothing, shown or not, and most are): right - x,
    LDA viewport_right_high         \ 16 bits
    SBC movers_x_high,X
    BCC each                        \ x > right: not on screen
    LDA need,X
    BMI c1_cand                     \ coming off: goes back on if still there
c1_rec = * + 1
    LDA rec_xh,X                    \ self-modified: rec_xh + boff
    INC A                           \ 65C02 opcode: &FF (not shown) -> 0
    BNE each                        \ shown and staying
.c1_cand                            \ not shown here, or coming off: it may go on
    LDA movers_x_low,X              \ C = 1 from here to the JSR: the right test's
    STA mover_x_low
    LDA movers_x_high,X
    BMI each                        \ no mover in the slot
    PHY                             \ the index: the callee takes Y (the x high) and X (the type)
    TAY
    LDA movers_type_and_colour,X
    AND #&7F
    TAX
    JSR is_left_c1_3d13             \ the left edge, past check_if_mover_is_on_screen's right one: carry set if not
    PLY                             \ (keeps C)
    BCS each
    LDX act,Y                       \ the slot
    DEY                             \ next's index (it takes the INY and each the DEY)
    STY ren_k
candidates.summary: mark_to_draw rebuilt (measured on the bench build, same game by pass: seed 1 -217.9, RIGHT -284.9 cycles a pass, 34422.4 -> 34204.5 and 39622.9 -> 39338.0; that includes 4.8 cycles a pass lost to the +7 byte slide of the code after it). (1) The act list is walked from its end: DEY/BMI, no CPY act_n, no STY ren_k and LDY ren_k a slot (each slot's need is judged alone). (2) The shown-here test reads rec_xh,X through a self-modified operand taken from classify's (render.classify_xh = LO(rec_xh) OR boff): no TXA/ADC boff/TAY, so Y stays the index. (3) check_if_mover_is_on_screen's right edge is done inline first, branch-free 16-bit (about 40% of the slots listed are off the right and now cost 25 cycles instead of about 100); need is tested before rec_xh. (4) What passes enters the callee at is_left_c1_3d13 (its left edge only: C = 1 as it expects, X = type, Y = x high, mover_x_low set), Y saved by PHY/PLY, no STA &C5, STX/LDX ren_i or ren_k traffic. (5) deletes the unused width_of_type_A (7 bytes) to pay for the code: net +7 bytes against 7 spare in the DEBUG_FULLREDRAW build (0 left after) and 9 in SKY_HELI=0. Alternatives c2 and c3 are the same lines, smaller.
candidates.equivalence: Every slot of act is judged on its own and only need[slot] |= &40 is written, so the order is free. For a slot: old = (need bit 7 set, or rec_xh = &FF) and movers_x_high bit 7 clear and check_if_mover_is_on_screen(x, type) clear -> need |= &40. New: right edge x <= right (LDA right_low / CMP x_low / LDA right_high / SBC x_high, C = right >= x as 16 bits, exactly the callee's CPY high / CMP low); fails -> nothing, which is what the old did for all three kinds of slot (a slot off the right is not marked whatever need and rec_xh say, and all that is skipped is pure reads). Then need bit 7 -> candidate; else rec_xh = &FF -> candidate; else (shown and staying) nothing: the old BMI/INC A/BNE with the arms reordered. Candidate: x high bit 7 -> nothing (BMI, as before); else the callee from is_left_c1_3d13 does what the old callee did after its right edge: it is reached by the old callee's own equal-high-bytes path with C = 1 (the CMP's carry) and by its SEC/BRA path, and here C = 1 from the SBC that passed (the INC A, LDA, STA, PHY, TAY, AND, TAX between leave C alone). Y = x high (the callee's LDY &C5), X = type, mover_x_low = x low (&F8, restored by restore_game_zp anyway); its INY in the overflow path only touches Y, which PLY restores. On C clear: X = the slot (LDX act,Y), ren_k = index - 1 so that next's LDY ren_k / INY / BRA each lands on each with Y = index and each's DEY gives index - 1; then the unchanged need |= &40. On C set: BCS each with Y = index. Dead afterwards: ren_i (set again by classify and close_over_overlaps' gather before any read), ren_k (set by gather and the take-off loop before any read), &C5 and &F8 (renderer scratch / restored), A, X, Y, flags (the caller does JSR close_over_overlaps, which sets its own). act_n = 0: LDY act_n, DEY gives &FF, BMI done. act_n is at most MOVER_SLOTS, so DEY never wraps to a positive. Checked: passlock seeds 1 (6000 passes) and 3 (4000) state and screen identical to the control, the DEBUG_FULLREDRAW twin identical to the new build (seed 5, 4000), helilock flights 5 and 2 with no frame differing, and the whole-world run.
candidates.relies_on: mark_to_draw is called once, from render after classify (render.6502:473), and nothing jumps into it past its label (grep mark_to_draw, .each, .candidate, .not_shown: only the JSR and the window's own branches; the labels are local to its braces). width_of_type_A (deleted, 7 bytes) has no caller: grep over src/, tools/ and docs/ finds only render.6502:453's comment 'width_of_type_A, inline'. (a) render.classify_xh (render.6502:421, `classify_xh = * + 1`) holds LO(rec_xh) OR boff: render stores it unconditionally (STA classify_xh) before the classify loop, boff is not changed between that and mark_to_draw, and render and mark_to_draw are both in bank 4 (reading and writing that RAM as classify does). (b) is_left_c1_3d13 in game.6502 (check_if_mover_is_on_screen's second half) keeps its contract: C = 1, X = type, Y = x high, mover_x_low = x low in, C out (clear = on screen), changes only A, Y (INY), flags; `grep is_left_c1_3d13 src/` finds only its label and the callee's own branches. A later candidate that changes that label or contract breaks this one (the build would fail to assemble if the label goes, but not if the contract changes). (c) Page crossings: mark_to_draw is now &9790-&97DD, every branch inside page &97 (the loop's branches are all backward within it) as before; the indexed reads (act &BC6E+Y, movers_* &1300-&13xx+X, rec_xh &B580/&B5C0+X, mover_types_width_table &DA55+X in the callee) cross no page. close_over_overlaps and everything after it slide up 7 bytes (&97D7 -> &97DE); the pcprof of the code after mark_to_draw costs 4.8 cycles a pass more at the new phase (11821.5 -> 11826.4, seed 1), already in the figures above. (d) Bank 4 room: +7 net; the DEBUG_FULLREDRAW build had exactly 7 bytes spare (this leaves 0), SKY_HELI=0 9; bench, ship, release, gameplay assemble. Another accepted candidate that grows bank 4 first will make this one 'no room': then c2 (+5) or c3 (-7). (e) the stack: PHY/PLY are balanced on every path after the PHY (JSR returns, PLY, then BCS; no branch leaves between them).

candidates.equivalence: As c1 for the walk, the right-edge filter (a slot off the right is never marked, whatever its need and rec_xh, and everything skipped is a pure read) and the shown/coming-off/not-shown test.
